name: LoomDesk MCP
description: Reviews LoomDesk's planning tools, which return unsigned Robinhood Chain transactions (open, add to, change or close a liquidity position, a limit order, a swap, a new pool) for the caller's own wallet to sign. LoomDesk holds no keys and signs nothing. Read tools keep Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use the read tools (market_tokens, ladder_pools, my_ladders, book_status) when no transaction is needed.
Keep the plan_* tools on Review: what they return moves the wallet's funds once signed, so check the amounts, the pool and the contract before signing.
